entry.title: BOSS BY BECKHAM Fall/Winter 26 | London launch event

media:group.media:title: BOSS BY BECKHAM Fall/Winter 26 | London launch event
media:group.media:description:
Explore some of the highlights from our launch event for the BOSS BY BECKHAM Fall/Winter 26 collection. Featuring timeless looks, live music, and friends of the brand, the gathering at The Hart in Marylebone, London, celebrated David Beckham’s signature sense of style. The latest collection draws inspiration from the great outdoors and quintessentially British style codes, showcasing heritage fabrics, muted shades, and relaxed silhouettes. Discover the full assortment at https://on.boss.com/BOSSBYBECKHAM/WI26 #BeYourOwnBOSS
